analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, convening its 34th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. The document details administrative procedures for remote e-voting and video conferencing, alongside notices for ordinary business and special business. The special business includes resolutions for the re-appointment of Independent and Whole-time Directors such as Dr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah and Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that global small business AI adoption surged, with about 68% of small business owners reporting they already use AI.
demand_outlook.quote: About 68% of small business owners report already using AI, up sharply from 51% just two years prior.

demand_outlook.claim: An additional 9% of small business owners plan to begin using AI within the next year.
demand_outlook.quote: An additional 9% plan to begin using AI within the next year, indicating that roughly three-quarters of small firms will soon be AI-powered.

demand_outlook.claim: Approximately 80% of small business owners see AI as an enabler of growth that enhances rather than replaces their workforce.
demand_outlook.quote: Crucially, most entrepreneurs see AI as an enabler of growth rather than a threat: around 80% say AI is enhancing (not replacing) their workforce, and nearly 40% plan to create new jobs in 2025 because of AI-driven productivity gains.

orders_capacity.claim: Calsoft's dSpeedUp digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

risks_headwinds.claim: Many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry surveys noted that 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: These efforts were aimed at closing the “resource and information gap” noted in industry surveys (e.g. 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: The company scheduled its thirty-fourth annual general meeting to be held on Tuesday, September 29, 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The register of members and share transfer books will remain closed from Tuesday, September 22, 2026, to Tuesday, September 29, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The Register of Members and the Share Transfer Books will remain closed from Tuesday, September 22nd, 2026 to Tuesday, September 29th, 2026 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of Annual General Meeting for the financial year 2025-2026.

management_commitments.claim: Calsoft remained committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, Calsofts remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs, ensuring that innovation is not just for the few, but for the many.
